question: Which bodily region should be colored by the splendor of the contemplated substance?
premises: This splendor can color the body.
The region of hair, shoulders, and skull is to be colored.
inference: One should color the region of the hair, shoulders, and skull with its splendor.
uncertainties: The compound keśa-skandha-kapāla-sthaṃ may refer to the head and upper body region.
plain_english: One should color the region of the hair, shoulders, and skull with its splendor.
